message.content: {"note_claim": "The image is edited: the original photo of an arrest showed a plain gray shirt and 'Latinos for Trump 2024' was digitally added, so it is not an authentic ICE photo.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "In the real photo, three agents are seen wearing Homeland Security Investigations, or HSI, vests, and are grabbing a man in a plain gray T-shirt by the arms.", "reason": "The page confirms the image is doctored from a real photo with a plain gray shirt, though it places the original in Salem, Ohio in 2018 (ICE/Getty) rather than a 2020 AP photo in Georgia as the note says."}

parsed.note_claim: The image is edited: the original photo of an arrest showed a plain gray shirt and 'Latinos for Trump 2024' was digitally added, so it is not an authentic ICE photo.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In the real photo, three agents are seen wearing Homeland Security Investigations, or HSI, vests, and are grabbing a man in a plain gray T-shirt by the arms.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the image is doctored from a real photo with a plain gray shirt, though it places the original in Salem, Ohio in 2018 (ICE/Getty) rather than a 2020 AP photo in Georgia as the note says.
